definition: permanently shadowed region (a cold trap that may host ice)

legend_stops.label: permanently shadowed region (a cold trap that may host ice)
not a qualifying permanently shadowed region

method: Classification input: PGDA LPSR raster, decoded value > 0.5 treated as shadowed. 8-connected component labeling (scipy.ndimage.label, 3x3 structure). Area filter: components retained only if pixel count >= 28 (>= 0.1 km^2 at 60 m/px). Euclidean distance transform (scipy.ndimage.distance_transform_edt) computed in projected metres, then divided by the per-pixel polar-stereographic scale factor k(lat)=2/(1+sin|lat|) to give true ground-distance kilometres.
nodata_encoding: fully transparent alpha channel (RGBA PNG); non-qualifying pixels are also transparent

source.citation: Mazarico, E., et al. (2011), Icarus, Vol. 211, pp. 1066-1081, doi:10.1016/j.icarus.2010.10.030
source.format: raster (not vector polygon/shapefile; see module docstring)
source.name: Permanent shadow classification (LPSR), 85S-90S, 60 m/px
